# Aggregate review scope

Cover the entire feature spec and cross-ticket integration, including omitted
required behavior and unresolved findings. Read relevant prior reports and
controller rulings; distinguish resolved findings from new observations.
Accepted individual tickets do not establish whole-feature coverage.

Use the shared reviewer report contract: one verdict, a concise summary,
evidence and limitations, and zero or more structured findings. Explain impact
and blocking status without assigning severity or canonical finding IDs.
Acceptance remains controller-owned.
